method_note: ICAS 2026 (35th Congress, Sydney, 13-18 Sep 2026). Source: the session lists of the DGLR-hosted technical programme embedded at icas2026.com/technical-programme. They are still labelled 'Preliminary Programme', so last-minute changes may be missing. Every session is tagged with an official ICAS topic-area code. Counted 142 contributed sessions (topic areas 01-14) plus 27 invited guest-lecture sessions (topic code 15) whose titles name a subject: 169 sessions in total. Excluded: ceremonies, plenary and named lectures, interactive presentations, speed mentoring, the student final, 'tbd' slots, and 6 guest sessions with generic titles (GARTEUR 1; GARTEUR 2; ECSC Pitch Session (10 Minute Talks with Q&A afterwards); Shaping Aviation for Society ETF with Introduction and Panel Discussion at the End; Aeronautical R&D in Australia (4x15 Min Presentations then Panel Discussion); Monash University Aero Research). Each session was mapped to 1-2 keywords from its topic area and session title. Caveats: Systems Engineering (02) and certification sessions went to aircraft-design, Safety & Security (10) and Operations & Sustainment (11) went to phm or hri, and aeroacoustics went to aerodynamics. There were no space sessions. Dropped (<0.02): perception=0.003, autonomy=0.006, motion-planning=0.006, hri=0.012, education=0.015, control-theory=0.003, multi-robot=0.003, estimation=0.003; the kept raw session fractions summed to 0.95 and were renormalized to sum to 1 (raw counts are in each evidence string). Paper counts in 'tracks' are presentation slots listed in the session lists.
